title: 2D Arrays
instructions: A 2D array is a grid — rows and columns. Think of a spreadsheet or a tic-tac-toe board.
int grid[2][3] makes 2 rows, each with 3 columns.
You reach a cell with two indexes: grid[row][column]. Both start at 0.
So grid[0][0] is the top-left, and grid[1][2] is the bottom-right of a 2x3 grid.
To visit every cell, use a loop inside a loop: the outer walks the rows, the inner walks the columns.
task: Fill in the indexes to print the bottom-right value (6).
hint:
Last row is index 1, last column is index 2:

    grid[1][2]
